edits.current: Payments in vouchers, cheques, cards or vales. Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 para. 6 imposes a HARD EXCLUSION: 'El value reportado en el numeral 7 NO DEBE CONTENER la information reportada en los demas numerales del Format 2276'. It is a residual concept, and double-reporting it against numerals 5, 8 or 17 is a validation failure. Meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026) are reported HERE, because the ET art. 387-1 exclusion does not apply to that employee (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pabop); for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT the same payment is split at 41 UVT between numeral 32 (element pagahuvt) and numeral 8 (element vaex) and nothing comes here. The 310-UVT test is applied month by month.
edits.proposed: Payments in vouchers, cheques, cards or vales. It is a residual concept, and double-reporting it against numerals 5, 8 or 17 is a validation failure. The 310-UVT test is applied month by month.

edits.current: The rolling six-month average that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper - full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026). The resolution restricts it expressly: 'UNICAMENTE para employees que aplique el numeral 4 art. 206 E.T.'. The engine must maintain the average YEAR-ROUND; it cannot be reconstructed from annual totals. HOW THE AVERAGE IS TAKEN: the monthly average SALARY ('salario mensual promedio', ET art. 206 num. 4) of six months - on termination or on a withdrawal of severance, the last six months of employment or the six months before the withdrawal; while the employment continues, the six months of the immediately preceding year at the time of the deposit to the fund; for employees outside the Ley 50 de 1990 regime, the six months before the employer recognises the severance (ET art. 27 num. 3) (DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025).
edits.proposed: The rolling six-month average that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper - full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026). The resolution restricts it expressly: 'UNICAMENTE para trabajadores que aplique el numeral 4 articulo 206 E.T.'. The engine must maintain the average YEAR-ROUND; it cannot be reconstructed from annual totals. HOW THE AVERAGE IS TAKEN: the monthly average SALARY ('salario mensual promedio', ET art. 206 num. 4) of six months - on termination or on a withdrawal of severance, the last six months of employment or the six months before the withdrawal; while the employment continues, the six months of the immediately preceding year at the time of the deposit to the fund; for employees outside the Ley 50 de 1990 regime, the six months before the employer recognises the severance (ET art. 27 num. 3) (DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025).
